question: According to the Living Planet Report 2020, ______ witnessed the highest decline in wildlife population.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Latin America**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2020 Living Planet Report, Latin America and the Caribbean experienced the highest decline in wildlife populations, with a loss of 94% since 1975**
 
• The **Living Planet Report is a science-based analysis published every two years by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF).**
 
• It **assesses the impact of human activity on the health of the planet**.
 
• The** 2020 report found that the loss of biodiversity is a threat to the well-being of current and future generations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** report also highlighted** the need for systemic changes to stop the destruction of wildlife populations, including overhauling food production and consumption, making global trade more sustainable, and removing deforestation from global supply chains. 
 
• **Here are the wildlife population declines in other regions: **
 
• **Africa: 76% decline**
 
• **Asia-Pacific: 60% decline**
 
• **Europe: Comparatively smaller decline**
 
• **Central Asia: 35% decline**
 
• **North America: 39% decline**
